scope: Optional SaaS/tools research preset and declared review metadata/sampling assessment

checks.check: Offline wheel build and real wheel ZIP import
checks.result: passed by preset worker; packaged JSON identical and 25 fields loaded

checks.check: Changed Markdown local links and code fences

verified_behaviors: Every selected field has a priority, questions, source references, comparison conditions and minimum evidence requirements.
Core field definitions are preserved; preset loading does not modify universal defaults, project approvals or existing locks.
Sources are discovery hints, not collected facts; product URLs must be actually discovered rather than guessed.
Preset resources are loaded from the installed Python package without cwd assumptions, network or state writes.
Sample metadata missing or marked unknown cannot fill coverage, including known repository markers uncollected/pending confirmation.
Declared publication/acquisition dates, explicit assessment window and rating scale are checked by code.
Source-domain mismatch, credentials and nonstandard review URL ports are excluded.
Unavailable/not-found/not-applicable or unchecked platforms retain issues rather than becoming zero-feedback successes.
URL duplicates and identical normalized review text do not fill two slots; possible duplicates require human review.
Known tracking parameters and www aliases normalize, while review identity query fields and individual-review anchors are preserved.
Duplicate contradictory JSON keys, malformed/deep/oversized input and non-regular files are safely rejected.
A complete declared sample still has facts_validated=false and cannot produce Validator PASS.
CLI preset remains an independent diagnostic and never creates a project, changes task state or generates a report.

fixed_findings: Tracking URL variants could double count one review.
Uncollected/pending-confirmation markers were treated as known role/company metadata.
Duplicate JSON fields used last-wins and could replace an unavailable outcome.

external_reference_checks.purpose: Official documentation checks for source catalog constraints, not competitor research or review collection.

references.supports: Partner review syndication requires a specific API key; it is not an implemented no-key collection channel.
The platform describes incentivized and non-incentivized reviews; preserve these labels and sample context.
Release mechanism documentation, applicable only to an actually related public repository.

existing_enforcement: Required collection metadata and lookup-state consistency.
Source snapshot integrity and exact candidate quote/locator checks.
Analysis reference IDs and state transition structure.
not_verified: Actual page retrieval and provenance of declared sample summaries.
Real review identity, source text or target-product match.
Quote entails claim, source authority, current truth or semantic conflicts.
Required competitor-by-dimension evidence coverage or price comparability.
Population representativeness or evidence-backed business report quality.
